posts.text: Will BTC go to zero? 😬 https://t.co/LZila03q2J
posts.reply_en: 💀 Bitcoin has been declared dead 400+ times since 2010, and 99Bitcoins keeps the obituary list. Zero would need every node worldwide to shut off at once. What's the actual failure path you'd bet on?
